failure.root_cause: INFRASTRUCTURE, coordinator-caused. All three SAEA Windows Scheduled Tasks stopped the instant the coordinator changed the power scheme with powercfg, because schtasks-created tasks carry the default stop-on-battery condition; the task-owned resident llama-server died mid-request and the campaign saw 'Remote end closed connection without response' / a broken pipe. Host memory was 45.6 GB free, there was no OOM, and there was no harness or config error. Code, configuration and request bytes are unchanged.
failure.fix: Outside this repository: the three scheduled tasks were re-registered with the battery and idle conditions disabled and no execution time limit, and the resident session was restarted under the same session id with unchanged identity fields.
